howItWorks.title: How Choseno works for you
howItWorks.subtitle: No complex setups. Three simple steps to join neighborhood discussions safely.
howItWorks.step1Text: Share your location once. We instantly match it to your real voting area — no forms to fill out, your privacy stays completely safe.
howItWorks.step2Text: Read real discussions from people in your voting area. Easily switch between your street, city, province, country, or global conversations.
howItWorks.step3Text: Share your opinion anonymously. Show your elected officials which local issues you care about most. They see real people speaking up, not bots or outsiders.

features.title: Designed for honest, local conversations
features.f1Text: Use a private name when you post. Switch to a new anonymous name anytime you want a fresh start.
features.f2Text: Politicians record video answers to voter questions. You get their real voice, not just written words.
features.f3Text: One person gets one vote. No fake accounts, no outsiders. Just real people from your area.
features.f4Text: Discuss your street, your city, your province, your country — or think globally. Pick what matters to you.
features.f5Text: Conversations stay local. You're talking with real people from your area who care about the same issues.
features.f6Text: We make sure you see discussions only from your actual voting area. No confusion about who represents you.

faqs.a: Yes. Your posts appear under a fake name, not your real one. You can get a new fake name anytime you want, and your old posts get disconnected from your profile.

faqs.q: Can politicians or staff see who I really am?
faqs.a: No. Nobody sees your real name. Your posts and profile are completely separate — even staff can't connect them. That's by design.

faqs.q: What happens when I get a new anonymous name?
faqs.a: Your old posts stay online but get a fresh start. When you switch to a new name, you're making a clean break from your past posts.

faqs.q: How do you know where I live without asking for my address?
faqs.a: We just need your location once. We match it to your voting area automatically — no forms, no typing an address.

faqs.q: Is Choseno run by a political party?
faqs.a: No. We show all candidates equally. A candidate's party doesn't matter to us — voters decide who they like.

faqs.q: Can I run for office without party support?
faqs.a: Yes. Any local resident can run. You just share a little about yourself, voters ask you questions, and you get your own campaign page.

faqs.q: What if my area isn't on the map yet?
faqs.a: You can search for your area by name or use your location. If it's not there yet, we're still adding new areas. Check back soon.

about.heroLead: Choseno started as a personal dream — not a startup pitch. It was born out of a simple frustration that millions of people share: we vote once, and then politicians do whatever they want.
about.bio1: I am a common person — not a politician, not a lobbyist, not a media company. I am someone who watches the news, votes in every election, and still feels like my voice disappears the moment I leave the polling booth.
about.bio2: Choseno is my personal contribution to the world. I built it because I genuinely believe people deserve to be part of the political conversation every single day of a politician's term — not just every two or four years on election day.
about.bio3: This platform is not funded by any political party, PAC, or corporate interest. It is an independent, self-started initiative. No agenda. No endorsements. Just a tool to help citizens find each other, share their real experiences with the people who represent them, and hold those representatives accountable through public opinion.
about.m1Text: Politics isn't a one-day event. Choseno gives citizens a permanent forum to ask questions, share feedback, and hold representatives accountable throughout their entire term.
about.m2Text: Most people have opinions but nowhere to share them safely. Choseno's anonymous Ghost ID system lets people speak honestly without fear of retribution.
about.m3Text: Choseno has no political affiliation and accepts no political donations. Every candidate is represented equally. Voters decide who gets a good rating — not us.
about.standard1Text: We do not rank candidates based on party affiliation or endorsement. Every verified candidate gets the exact same presentation.
about.standard2Title: Verified Voters & One Person, One Vote
about.standard2Text: To prevent bots, brigading, and foreign interference, all location-based votes are tied to real, verified electoral boundaries.
about.standard3Text: Your real identity is never exposed on posts or ratings. We protect citizen privacy while maintaining high-trust community signals.
